name: Blackberry
description: Blackberry (genus Rubus, subgenus Rubus, the Rubus fruticosus aggregate; most modern commercial cultivars are complex interspecific hybrids). Like raspberry, commercial cultivars split into floricane (summer-fruiting) and primocane (fall-fruiting) types, and separately into erect, semi-erect and trailing cane habits and thorny vs. thornless selections -- distinctions that drive trellising, machine-harvest suitability and regional fit. Created as part of the multi-berry portability audit (2026-08-20) to give berry_ids a resolvable target for berry-blackberry, mirroring berry-blueberry's own record and the same previously-identified gap (schema-assessment.md A-3, proposed-schema-enhancements.md P-1) that had only been fixed for blueberry.
